en.title: Gut & Regularity
en.who: Guests who mark not going every day, loose stools, heavy or bloated after meals, stress going straight to the gut, being thrown off by travel, or lots of takeout and few vegetables.
studyWhy: most illness starts in the gut

say: I totally get it. Some days nothing happens, other days you're running to the bathroom, and after a big meal you just feel heavy and puffy. And it's not something people really talk about, right?
feel.tip: Say back what they marked, in their words. Then ask: "Is it more too hard, too loose, or bloated after you eat?"

say: Honestly, I've been there. [Your story in a line or two: when it was, what it felt like, what you tried that didn't work.]
felt.tip: Your own story, or someone close to you ("my mom", "a friend from work"). No story yet? "A lot of the people I talk to say exactly the same thing." Never make one up.

say: What I learned is that being constipated and having loose stools usually aren't opposite problems. It's the same one: the stool has the wrong amount of water in it. Fibre is what holds that water, and most of us eat about half of what we need. Drinking more water only helps once the fibre is there.

Then the good bacteria turn that fibre into what keeps things moving. And the gut runs on a clock: it pushes hardest after you wake up and after breakfast. So warm water first thing, a real breakfast, and ten unhurried minutes after it do more than people think.
So this is what I'd start with.
found.tip: Two or three sentences, then go to the map. Pick the row that matches what they marked.

map: Not going every day
Prebiotic Fiber, raised a little each week, with a full glass of water
Holds water in the stool. A top-up, not a laxative
Still hard and slow
Magnesium, in the evening with water
A gentle form that covers a gap a lot of adults have, not a laxative. Kidney issues? Ask the doctor first
Loose stools
Prebiotic Fiber, start small, with water
Soaks up the extra water and gives it shape
Hard or loose, either way
Probiotic, daily with food, alongside the fibre
Good bacteria turn fibre into what keeps things moving. Judge it at four weeks
Heavy and bloated after big meals
Digestive Enzyme with that meal, or Begin Daily GI Primer
Helps break the meal down. Use it on the meals you feel it, not every day by default
Stress goes straight to the gut
Stress Relief Probiotic, in place of the regular one
The gut and the brain talk both ways. Pick one probiotic, not both
Thrown off by travel
Prebiotic Fiber in the bag; Begin 30 Holistic Wellness Solution to reset at home
Restaurant food is low in fibre. Keep the anchor: warm water, breakfast, ten minutes
Lots of takeout, few vegetables
Plant Protein Powder at breakfast; Green Superfood on the no-vegetable days
The gut lining is built from protein. Keep the vegetables, protein doesn't do fibre's job
en.ask: Based on what you told me, I'd start with the Prebiotic Fiber and the Probiotic, taken together. Do you want to take it home tonight?
en.doctor: Blood in the stool, black stool, weight loss they can't explain, loose stools with fever or lasting more than a few days, or a change that doesn't go away, especially after 50? See a doctor first.

zh.title: 肠胃与排便
zh.who: 适合在问卷里勾了几天才上一次、大便不成形、一吃饱就又撑又胀、一紧张就想跑厕所、一出门就不规律，或者外卖多蔬菜少的客人。

say: 我特别懂。有时候好几天都上不出来，有时候又一直跑厕所，吃顿大餐就撑得难受。而且这种事，也不太好意思跟别人说，对吧？
feel.tip: 用对方自己的话，把问卷上勾的说回去。然后问一句：“是偏干、偏稀，还是吃完就胀？”

say: 说实话，我也经历过。[你的故事，一两句就好：什么时候、什么感觉、试过什么没用。]
felt.tip: 讲你自己的，或者身边人的（“我妈妈”“我一个同事”）。还没有故事？就说：“我身边很多朋友也是这样。”千万别编。

say: 我后来才知道，便秘和拉稀，很多时候不是两个相反的问题，而是同一件事：大便里的水分不对。能把水留住的是纤维，可大多数人每天只吃到需要量的一半左右。纤维够了，多喝水才真的有用。
然后，肠道里的好菌会把纤维变成推着肠道走的东西。肠道还有自己的时钟，起床后和早饭后最想动。所以早上一杯温水、好好吃顿早饭、饭后留十分钟，比你想的管用。
所以，我会先从这个开始。
found.tip: 两三句就够，然后看下面的对照表，挑跟对方勾的那一项对得上的。

map: 几天才上一次
益生元纤维粉，每周慢慢加量，每次配一大杯水
把水分留在大便里。是补缺口，不是泻药
还是又干又硬
镁片，晚上配水吃
温和好吸收，补的是很多人都有的缺口，不是泻药。有肾脏问题的先问医生
大便不成形
益生元纤维粉，从少量开始，配一杯水
把多余的水分吸住，让它成形
偏干偏稀都适用
益生菌，每天随餐，和纤维一起吃
好菌把纤维变成推动肠道的东西。吃满四周再看
一吃饱就又撑又胀
消化酶，大餐时随餐吃；或者Begin每日肠道启动粉
帮忙把这顿饭分解掉。会胀的那几顿用，不用天天吃
一紧张就想跑厕所
舒压益生菌，替换普通益生菌
肠道和大脑是双向沟通的。二选一，不要叠加
一出门就不规律
益生元纤维粉随身带；回家想重新调，用Begin 30全人健康方案
外面的饭菜纤维少。守住起床温水、早餐、饭后十分钟
外卖多，蔬菜少
早餐换成有机植物蛋白粉；吃不上蔬菜的日子用绿色超级食物粉
肠道黏膜的原料是蛋白质。蔬菜还是要吃，蛋白质替代不了纤维
zh.ask: 按你刚才说的，我建议先从益生元纤维粉和益生菌开始，两样一起吃。今天要不要先带回去？
zh.doctor: 如果大便带血或发黑、体重不明原因下降、拉肚子伴发烧或持续好几天，或者排便习惯变了一直没恢复，特别是50岁以上，请先去看医生。
